    public $y;

        $this->x = $x;
        $this->y = $y;
    }

    public function set($x, $y) {
        $this->x = $x;
        $this->y = $y;
    }

    public function add(Point $p) {
        return new Point($this->x + $p->x, $this->y + $p->y);
    }

    public function sub(Point $p) {
        return new Point($this->x - $p->x, $this->y - $p->y);
    }

    public function mul($k) {
        return new Point($this->x * $k, $this->y * $k);
    }

    public function div($k) {
        return $this->mul(1.0 / $k);
    }

    public function rot90() {
        return new Point(-$this->y, $this->x);
    }

    public function mod() {
        return sqrt($this->x * $this->x + $this->y * $this->y);
    }

    public function mod2() {
        return $this->x * $this->x + $this->y * $this->y;
    }

    public function unit() {
        $m = $this->mod();
        return $this->div($m);
    }
}

const EPS = 1e-6;
const PI = M_PI;

function dot(Point $a, Point $b) {
    return $a->x * $b->x + $a->y * $b->y;
}

function cross(Point $a, Point $b) {
    return $a->x * $b->y - $a->y * $b->x;
}

    $den = $a->mod() * $b->mod();

    $cos = dot($a, $b) / $den;
    if ($cos > 1) $cos = 1;
    if ($cos < -1) $cos = -1;
    return acos($cos);
}

function rotate(Point $v, $alpha) {
    $sa = sin($alpha);
    $ca = cos($alpha);
    return new Point($v->x * $ca - $v->y * $sa, $v->x * $sa + $v->y * $ca);
}

function projectOnLine(Point $p, Point $a, Point $b) {
    $ab = $b->sub($a);
    $ap = $p->sub($a);
    $abUnit = $ab->unit();
    $len = dot($ab, $ap) / $ab->mod();
    return $a->add($abUnit->mul($len));
}

function lineCircleIntersection(Point $a, Point $b, Point $o, $r) {
    $ret = [];
    $t = projectOnLine($o, $a, $b);
    $ot = $t->sub($o);
    $d = $ot->mod();
    if ($d - $r > EPS) return $ret;
    if (abs($d - $r) < EPS) {
        $ret[] = $t;
        return $ret;
    }
    $lr = sqrt($r * $r - $ot->mod2());

    $tbDir = $t->sub($b)->unit();
    $ret[] = $t->add($taDir->mul($lr));
    $ret[] = $t->add($tbDir->mul($lr));
    return $ret;
}
